items.title: Agro Simulator: Season 26
items.description: Agro Simulator: Season 26 is a modern farming simulator where you operate machinery, grow crops, protect your fields, and expand your business. Turn a small plot of land into a thriving agricultural empire.

items.title: Command- Omega 2
items.description: Command-Ω 2 is a fast-paced synthwave tower defense shooter with deep roguelite mechanics. Defend your neon base against relentless hordes, unlock devastating abilities like Chain Lightning, and adapt your run with game-changing mutators. Survive the cyber-onslaught and upgrade your arsenal!

items.title: Harvest Hand
items.description: Harvest Hand is a cozy turn-based strategy game where cards are your farming tools. Plant crops, manage water and energy, adapt to changing weather and threats, and build a powerful deck as you complete increasingly challenging orders.

items.title: Denkou Love - Starting an Electrician's Job from Scratch -
items.description: 第二種電気工事士に、物語で合格する。試験団体公表の過去問1000問（令和元〜8年度）と本番形式のCBT模擬試験を収録した学習ビジュアルノベル。45歳で人生をやり直す主人公と5人のヒロインの物語を読み進めるうちに、試験範囲が自然と身につく。配線図記号や法規は暗記カード428枚とSVG図解でスキマ時間に。頻出テーマを掘り下げる黒板チャンネル38本、選択肢ごとの詳しい解説、通信不要のオフラインAIアシスタントも収録。参考書で挫折した人へ。

items.title: Summon Stone
items.description: A fusion of puzzles and tower defense! Use puzzles to break summon stones and summon monsters corresponding to those stones. Switch between two decks to stack and destroy summon stones, then summon monsters. Summon powerful monsters with massive chain reactions and overwhelm your enemies.

Repterra
items.description: Repterra is a base-building survival RTS set in a world overrun by dinosaurs. Manage your colony while battling massive dino hordes. Breed and ride your own dinos, unlock permanent upgrades, and fight to reclaim the world for humanity.

items.title: Can Your Otaku Cabinet Grow a Beautiful Girl?
items.description: 这是一款简单的种花和养花的休闲挂机游戏。

items.title: Rythix 2048
items.description: Slide and merge numbers — and hear your own techno track come alive. Every move triggers a note, every game generates a fresh electronic groove, and the DJ Deck lets you remix it live while you play. A number puzzle that is secretly a music instrument.

items.title: Planet Fatta
items.description: The battle for Planet Fatta has begun! Dark forces have occupied its cities and are destroying all life. The Guardian of the Ari creates a robot powered by light energy. Infiltrate the enemy’s capital and destroy the source of their power.

items.title: Slot & Learn WORLD FLAGS
items.description:
Know that flag?

Learn world flags and country names in a fun, game-like way.
No complicated controls needed. Read the prompt, look closely at the four flag images, and pick the flag that matches.

How to play is simple!
・Check the text shown on the screen
・Think about the country name and its flag
・Choose the correct flag from the four images

From flags you may have seen before to flags with similar shapes and colors, each round is a quick chance to test what you know.
Play again and again to gradually get more familiar with flags and country names.

It is easy to enjoy in short sessions, whether you are checking your own knowledge or talking through answers with family.

Recommended for players who:
・Are curious about flags from around the world
・Want a fun way to review countries and geography
・Are looking for a learning game to enjoy with kids
・Prefer simple controls
・Want to learn a little at a time during spare moments

How many flags can you recognize?
Picture countries around the world and aim for a perfect score!

Playable with buttons or touch controls.

items.title: Nether Meridian
items.description: Runner × FPS. A challenging fusion of a forward-running game and a first-person shooter.

items.title: Build My Arcade
items.description:
Build your dream arcade from the ground up!

Start with just a handful of arcade machines and a small budget, then grow your business into the ultimate entertainment destination. Every machine earns money, every upgrade attracts more customers, and every decision shapes the future of your arcade.

Expand your floor with new game cabinets, purchase furniture, and unlock bigger, better attractions as your arcade grows. Manage your profits wisely, reinvest in your business, and transform a tiny game room into a thriving arcade empire.

Features:
> Start with a small arcade and expand over time.
> Buy a variety of arcade machines.
> Earn money from customers and reinvest your profits.
>Purchase furniture to improve your arcade's appearance.
> Build the ultimate arcade and become the best in town!

Will you create the most popular arcade in town?

items.title: Cat Rhapsody
items.description: "Cat Rhapsody" is a fun and easy-to-learn platforming game. You'll play as an agile Lihua cat, exploring over a dozen carefully designed miniature sandbox maps within a limited time. Try to smash all the cups and finally escape the house!

items.title: Aerialia: Wings of Delivery
items.description:
Take to the skies, deliver with care, and connect a peaceful world one package at a time.

Become a cheerful delivery bird and explore a colorful archipelago filled with charming villages, friendly characters, and countless deliveries waiting to be completed.

Fly freely between beautiful islands, collect letters, parcels, and special cargo, then deliver them safely to homes across the world. Every successful delivery rewards you with coins that can be used to upgrade your equipment and unlock new possibilities.

Customize your delivery cart with stronger wheels that allow you to transport heavier packages, then enhance them with powerful badges that provide unique bonuses such as increased delivery rewards, faster progression, and improved earnings.

Master dynamic delivery challenges by flying through speed boost rings to maintain momentum, improve your routes, and complete deliveries as quickly as possible.

Discover new islands, meet memorable villagers, improve your delivery business, and become the greatest courier the skies have ever known.

items.title: Dodge All the Things
items.description: Dodge your way through three brutal levels of deadly enemies (and lasers) that kill you in an instant. Collect diamonds until you have enough to make it out alive. Can you dodge your way past everything and take down the final boss?

items.title: Hollow Hide
items.description: Hollow Hide — asymmetric hide-and-seek with new mechanics. Gather resources for disguise, signal your friends, run from the hunter. Or play as the hunter — track down escaped test subjects and shoot them with your rifle

items.title: Catnip Wars
items.description: Sci-fi tower defense game. Control your catbot. Farm your catnip. Build turrets to defend against endless waves of Necronazis.

items.title: Hoop Empire
items.description: Draft rookies, negotiate trades, manage your cap, and create your dream franchise in this deep basketball management sim. Choose your path as a coach or an owner of one of 30 teams and build a championship dynasty one decision at a time. Customize rosters or draft classes for a unique experience.

items.title: Block Wise
items.description: Solve spatial puzzles in a world of blocks. Find the logic of each shape and build the perfect solution.

items.title: Beach Volleyball Boys: Hot Spike
items.description:
The summer roster has one spot left, and everyone on the sand is just as determined to take it as you are. Somewhere between the drills and the downtime, it stopped being just about volleyball.

One reads every play before it happens. One stays guarded until you've actually earned a place in his world. Another is warm and easy until the score gets close, then turns sharp and unreadable. And the captain isn't letting anyone in who hasn't proven he's worth the risk.

Say the right thing and something shifts. Say the wrong thing and you're back on the bench. Thirty days until the season opener, and every day you wait is a day someone else gets closer.
